body:
If this question interests you, you’ll want to check out my e-book with that title. I examine John 14:6 (“I am the way … no one comes to the Father but by me”) in its immediate context, as well as in the larger context of John and his unique angle on Jesus and his message. It’s only $3.99, and you can order here:  /archive/store

 You’ll find a lot of other resources there too – music, e-books, overviews of the Bible, etc.
